documents.title: Airport Shuttle Schedule Change
documents.text: Effective June 1, the Skyline Shuttle between Clearwater Airport and downtown will run every 20 minutes instead of every 30 minutes between 6 a.m. and 10 p.m. Overnight service, from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m., will continue hourly. The fare will increase from $8 to $9 one way, but round-trip tickets purchased online will remain $14. Passengers with mobility needs can request a vehicle with a wheelchair lift by calling 555-0133 at least 24 hours before travel. Pick-up is at Door 4 of Terminal 1 and Door 2 of Terminal 2.

documents.title: Port of Kessler to Double Container Capacity
documents.text: KESSLER (March 14) - The Port of Kessler has approved a $120 million expansion that will double its container-handling capacity by 2028. [A] Construction will begin in January and include a new pier, four additional cranes, and an expanded rail yard. [B] Port director Alan Whitcomb said the project was prompted by a 30 percent increase in cargo volume over the past five years. [C] Local residents have raised concerns about noise and truck traffic; the port has promised to build a sound barrier and to restrict truck deliveries to daytime hours. [D] The expansion is expected to create 400 construction jobs and 150 permanent positions, according to a study commissioned by the port authority.

questions.prompt: What does the article announce?
choices: The closing of a rail yard
Plans to enlarge a shipping port
questions.explanation: The port has approved a $120 million expansion.

questions.prompt: What has the port promised local residents?
questions.explanation: It promised a sound barrier and daytime-only truck deliveries.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about cargo traffic at the port?
choices: It is controlled by local residents
questions.explanation: Cargo volume rose 30 percent in five years.

questions.prompt: In which position marked [A], [B], [C] or [D] does the following sentence best belong? "Whitcomb added that the existing facilities can no longer handle peak-season demand."
questions.explanation: It must directly follow the sentence reporting Whitcomb's explanation of the project.

documents.title: Savor Cooking School
documents.text:
Beginner Basics (4 weeks, $160): knife skills, sauces, and simple dinners.
Pastry Workshop (3 weeks, $210): breads, pies, and cakes.
Italian Evenings (6 weeks, $290): pasta, risotto, and regional specialties.

All classes are limited to 12 students and held in our professional kitchen. Ingredients and aprons are provided. Cancel at least 7 days before the first class for a full refund; later cancellations receive a credit toward a future class. Gift certificates are available.

documents.title: Worth every penny
documents.text:
Savor Cooking School: 5 stars out of 5
Posted by Michael R.

I took the Pastry Workshop last spring after years of failed attempts at baking bread. The instructor, Chef Anna, was patient and explained why each step matters, not just how. With only twelve students, we all got personal feedback. My only suggestion is that the classes run late; ours finished 30 minutes past the scheduled time. I have since signed up for Italian Evenings and bought a gift certificate for my sister.

documents.title: Remote work policy
documents.text:
TO: All employees
FROM: Janet Ocampo, VP Human Resources
DATE: January 8
SUBJECT: Remote work policy

Beginning February 1, employees may work from home up to two days per week, subject to manager approval. Employees must be in the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays for team meetings. Remote workers are responsible for maintaining a reliable internet connection; the company will reimburse up to $30 per month for home internet. Equipment such as monitors can be borrowed from IT for the duration of the arrangement. Requests should be submitted through the HR portal by January 25.
